findings.description: Round-2 frontmatter and distribution spec scenarios added to `specs/skill-workflow/spec.md` ('Frontmatter omits triggers and sets Architecture category', 'Skill markdown ends with required tail sections', 'Manifest declares portable distribution and atlas dependencies', 'Sibling skill paths use skill-base-dir form') are not wired into `tasks.md`. Phase 2 tasks (tasks 2.1, 2.3, 2.6, 2.7) should list these scenarios under their `Spec scenarios:`.

The requirement 'Atlas Symbol Tree Export' states that `<target>` SHALL resolve as module file path or basename ('then module file path or basename (rooting the tree at the module with its own symbols as hop 1)'), but only module basename is verified in 'Scenario: File target gives the aggregated module view' (`--tree <file-basename>`). Resolution by module file path lacks a corresponding WHEN/THEN scenario.

In `session-log.md` under '## Phase: Plan Review (2026-09-16)', '### Next Steps' is positioned prematurely between round 1 decisions (1–4) and round 2 decisions (5–7). Additionally, round 3 adjudication is recorded in `plan-findings.md` with revision bumped to 5, but is missing from `session-log.md`.

In `design.md` D7, test check 1 instructs asserting 'the closed ungrounded reason set `graph stale|absent|check failed`, `symbol not in graph`, `form not graph-backed` present as exact tokens'. The shorthand pipe syntax `graph stale|absent|check failed` contradicts task 2.2 and D5, which specify the exact tokens as separate strings (`graph stale`, `graph absent`, `graph check failed`).

In `.review-ledger/ledger.json`, all items 1–13 are stamped with `first_seen_round: 1`, `last_seen_round: 1`, and `retired_reason: "plan-review-adjudication-round-3"`, even though items 9–13 were raised in round 2 and `plan-findings.md` states rounds 1–2 ledger items were retired after round 2 adjudication. Furthermore, item 11 was marked retired in round 3 without being mentioned or addressed in the round 3 adjudication in `plan-findings.md`.
